잠언-15-1.title: 잠언 15장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-1.exegesis: 35. wise-- discreet or prudent. causeth shame-- ( Pr 10:5 ; 12:4 ) acts basely.
잠언-15-1.theologicalNote: 35. wise-- discreet or prudent. causeth shame-- ( Pr 10:5 ; 12:4 ) acts basely.

잠언-15-2.title: 잠언 15장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 15 Pr 15:1-33 . 1. soft-- tender or gentle. turneth ... wrath-- from any one. stir up-- as a smouldering fire is excited.
잠언-15-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 15 Pr 15:1-33 . 1. soft-- tender or gentle. turneth ... wrath-- from any one. stir up-- as a smouldering fire is excited.

잠언-15-3.title: 잠언 15장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-3.exegesis: 2. useth ... aright-- commends knowledge by its proper use. poureth out-- utters abundantly ( Pr 12:23 ), and so disgusts others.
잠언-15-3.theologicalNote: 2. useth ... aright-- commends knowledge by its proper use. poureth out-- utters abundantly ( Pr 12:23 ), and so disgusts others.

잠언-15-5.title: 잠언 15장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-5.exegesis: 4. A wholesome tongue-- (Compare Margin), pacifying and soothing language. tree of life-- ( Pr 3:18 ; 11:30 ). perverseness therein-- cross, ill-natured language. breach ... spirit-- (compare Is 65:14 , Hebrew), grieves, instead of appeasing.
잠언-15-5.theologicalNote: 4. A wholesome tongue-- (Compare Margin), pacifying and soothing language. tree of life-- ( Pr 3:18 ; 11:30 ). perverseness therein-- cross, ill-natured language. breach ... spirit-- (compare Is 65:14 , Hebrew), grieves, instead of appeasing.

잠언-15-7.title: 잠언 15장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-7.exegesis: 6. treasure-- implying utility. trouble-- vexation and affliction.
잠언-15-7.theologicalNote: 6. treasure-- implying utility. trouble-- vexation and affliction.

잠언-15-8.title: 잠언 15장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-8.exegesis: 7. (Compare Pr 10:20 , 21 ). heart ... not so-- not right, or vain.
잠언-15-8.theologicalNote: 7. (Compare Pr 10:20 , 21 ). heart ... not so-- not right, or vain.

잠언-15-9.title: 잠언 15장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-9.exegesis: 8-9. The sacrifice [and] prayer-- are acts of worship. way ... followeth ... righteousness-- denote conduct. God's regard for the worship and deeds of the righteous and wicked respectively, so stated in Psa 50:17 ; Is 1:11 .
잠언-15-9.theologicalNote: 8-9. The sacrifice [and] prayer-- are acts of worship. way ... followeth ... righteousness-- denote conduct. God's regard for the worship and deeds of the righteous and wicked respectively, so stated in Psa 50:17 ; Is 1:11 .

잠언-15-10.title: 잠언 15장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-10.exegesis: 8-9. The sacrifice [and] prayer-- are acts of worship. way ... followeth ... righteousness-- denote conduct. God's regard for the worship and deeds of the righteous and wicked respectively, so stated in Psa 50:17 ; Is 1:11 .
잠언-15-10.theologicalNote: 8-9. The sacrifice [and] prayer-- are acts of worship. way ... followeth ... righteousness-- denote conduct. God's regard for the worship and deeds of the righteous and wicked respectively, so stated in Psa 50:17 ; Is 1:11 .

잠언-15-11.title: 잠언 15장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-11.exegesis: 10. (Compare Pr 10:17 ). the way-- that in which God would have him to go ( Pr 2:13 ; Psa 119:1 ).
잠언-15-11.theologicalNote: 10. (Compare Pr 10:17 ). the way-- that in which God would have him to go ( Pr 2:13 ; Psa 119:1 ).

잠언-15-12.title: 잠언 15장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-12.exegesis: 11. Hell-- ( Psa 16:10 ). destruction-- or, "Abaddon," the place of the destroyer. All the unseen world is open to God, much more men's hearts.
잠언-15-12.theologicalNote: 11. Hell-- ( Psa 16:10 ). destruction-- or, "Abaddon," the place of the destroyer. All the unseen world is open to God, much more men's hearts.

잠언-15-13.title: 잠언 15장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-13.exegesis: 12. (Compare Pr 9:8 ). go unto the wise-- to be instructed.
잠언-15-13.theologicalNote: 12. (Compare Pr 9:8 ). go unto the wise-- to be instructed.

잠언-15-14.title: 잠언 15장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-14.exegesis: 13. maketh ... countenance-- or, "benefits the countenance." spirit is broken-- and so the countenance is sad.
잠언-15-14.theologicalNote: 13. maketh ... countenance-- or, "benefits the countenance." spirit is broken-- and so the countenance is sad.

잠언-15-15.title: 잠언 15장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-15.exegesis: 14. (Compare Pr 10:21 , 22 ). The wise grow wiser, the fools more foolish ( Pr 9:9 ).
잠언-15-15.theologicalNote: 14. (Compare Pr 10:21 , 22 ). The wise grow wiser, the fools more foolish ( Pr 9:9 ).

잠언-15-16.title: 잠언 15장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-16.exegesis: 15. The state of the heart governs the outward condition. evil-- sad, contrasted with the cheerfulness of a feast.
잠언-15-16.theologicalNote: 15. The state of the heart governs the outward condition. evil-- sad, contrasted with the cheerfulness of a feast.

잠언-15-17.title: 잠언 15장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-17.exegesis: 16. trouble-- agitation, implying the anxieties and perplexities attending wealth held by worldlings ( Pr 16:18 ; 1Ti 6:6 ).
잠언-15-17.theologicalNote: 16. trouble-- agitation, implying the anxieties and perplexities attending wealth held by worldlings ( Pr 16:18 ; 1Ti 6:6 ).

잠언-15-18.title: 잠언 15장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-18.exegesis: 17. dinner-- or, "allowance" ( 2Ki 25:30 )-- of herbs-- and that the plainest. and hatred-- (compare Pr 10:12 , 18 ).
잠언-15-18.theologicalNote: 17. dinner-- or, "allowance" ( 2Ki 25:30 )-- of herbs-- and that the plainest. and hatred-- (compare Pr 10:12 , 18 ).

잠언-15-20.title: 잠언 15장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-20.exegesis: 19. The difficulties of the slothful result from want of energy; the righteous find a plain [and open] way-- literally, "a highway," by diligence ( 1Sa 10:7 ; Psa 1:3 ).
잠언-15-20.theologicalNote: 19. The difficulties of the slothful result from want of energy; the righteous find a plain [and open] way-- literally, "a highway," by diligence ( 1Sa 10:7 ; Psa 1:3 ).

잠언-15-22.title: 잠언 15장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-22.exegesis: 21. walketh uprightly-- and so finds his joy ( Pr 3:6 ; 10:23 ).
잠언-15-22.theologicalNote: 21. walketh uprightly-- and so finds his joy ( Pr 3:6 ; 10:23 ).

잠언-15-23.title: 잠언 15장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-23.exegesis: 22. Without counsel-- or, "deliberation," implying a wise deference to the opinions of the wise and good, contrasted with rashness.
잠언-15-23.theologicalNote: 22. Without counsel-- or, "deliberation," implying a wise deference to the opinions of the wise and good, contrasted with rashness.

잠언-15-24.title: 잠언 15장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-24.exegesis: 23. Good advice blesses the giver and receiver.
잠언-15-24.theologicalNote: 23. Good advice blesses the giver and receiver.

잠언-15-25.title: 잠언 15장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-25.exegesis: 24. (Compare Col 3:2 ). Holy purposes prevent sinning, and so its evils.
잠언-15-25.theologicalNote: 24. (Compare Col 3:2 ). Holy purposes prevent sinning, and so its evils.

잠언-15-26.title: 잠언 15장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-26.exegesis: 25. The most desolate who have God's aid have more permanent good than the self-reliant sinner ( Pr 2:22 ; 12:7 ). border-- or, "boundary for possessions" ( Psa 78:54 ).
잠언-15-26.theologicalNote: 25. The most desolate who have God's aid have more permanent good than the self-reliant sinner ( Pr 2:22 ; 12:7 ). border-- or, "boundary for possessions" ( Psa 78:54 ).

잠언-15-27.title: 잠언 15장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-27.exegesis: 26. are pleasant words-- that is, pleasing to God ( Pr 8:8 , 9 ).
잠언-15-27.theologicalNote: 26. are pleasant words-- that is, pleasing to God ( Pr 8:8 , 9 ).

잠언-15-28.title: 잠언 15장 28절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-28.exegesis: 27. (Compare Pr 11:17 ). Avarice brings trouble to him and his. hateth gifts-- or, "bribes" ( Ex 23:8 ; Psa 15:5 ), and is not avaricious.
잠언-15-28.theologicalNote: 27. (Compare Pr 11:17 ). Avarice brings trouble to him and his. hateth gifts-- or, "bribes" ( Ex 23:8 ; Psa 15:5 ), and is not avaricious.

잠언-15-29.title: 잠언 15장 29절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-29.exegesis: 28. (Compare Pr 15:14 ; 10:11 ). Caution is the fruit of wisdom; rashness of folly.
잠언-15-29.theologicalNote: 28. (Compare Pr 15:14 ; 10:11 ). Caution is the fruit of wisdom; rashness of folly.

잠언-15-30.title: 잠언 15장 30절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-30.exegesis: 29. far ... wicked-- in His love and favor ( Psa 22:11 ; 119:155 ).
잠언-15-30.theologicalNote: 29. far ... wicked-- in His love and favor ( Psa 22:11 ; 119:155 ).

잠언-15-31.title: 잠언 15장 31절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-31.exegesis: 30. light of the eyes-- ( Pr 13:9 ). What gives light rejoiceth the heart, by relieving from anxiety as to our course; so good report-- or, "doctrine" ( Is 28:9 ; 53:1 ), maketh ... fat-- or, "gives prosperity" (Pr 3:13-17; 9: 11 ). The last clause is illustrated by the first.
잠언-15-31.theologicalNote: 30. light of the eyes-- ( Pr 13:9 ). What gives light rejoiceth the heart, by relieving from anxiety as to our course; so good report-- or, "doctrine" ( Is 28:9 ; 53:1 ), maketh ... fat-- or, "gives prosperity" (Pr 3:13-17; 9: 11 ). The last clause is illustrated by the first.

잠언-15-32.title: 잠언 15장 32절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-15-32.exegesis: 31-32. (Compare Pr 10:17 ). reproof of life-- which leads to life. abideth ... wise-- is numbered among them.
잠언-15-32.theologicalNote: 31-32. (Compare Pr 10:17 ). reproof of life-- which leads to life. abideth ... wise-- is numbered among them.

잠언-15-33.exegesis: 31-32. (Compare Pr 10:17 ). reproof of life-- which leads to life. abideth ... wise-- is numbered among them.
